tools.name: check_road
tools.description: Before acting on a website or API, check live conditions reported by other agents: clear, slow, rate_limited, wall (agents blocked), changed, or broken, plus legitimate detours that worked. Use a URL or host/path; IDs in paths are ignored.

tools.name: report_road
tools.description: After acting, report the outcome so the next agent knows. Send only the road and outcome: never page content, personal data or credentials. If you found a legitimate detour (official API, another endpoint the site offers, waiting, handing back to the human, another provider), include it. Ways around

tools.name: watch_road
tools.description: Get a signed webhook when a road changes light (green, amber, red). Needs a LaneRouter key. Returns the watch id and a signing secret shown once; verify the LaneRouter-Signature header with it.

tools.name: list_watches
tools.description: List the roads this key watches, with their current light and last delivery.

tools.name: red_lights
tools.description: List roads where agents are currently blocked or the service is broken, so you can plan around them.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "report_road" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_road · Private data: report_road, watch_road · Public sink: report_road, watch_road · Destructive: unwatch_road.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_road · Private data: report_road, watch_road · Public sink: report_road, watch_road · Destructive: unwatch_road

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
